[Unit]
Description=Inventory application on TCP port 8181
After=network.target apparmor.service
Requires=apparmor.service

[Service]
Type=simple
User=nobody
Group=nogroup
Environment=PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
Environment=INVENTORY_BIND=0.0.0.0
Environment=INVENTORY_PORT=8181
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/aa-exec -p inventory-app -- /usr/bin/python3 /opt/inventory-app/server.py
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true
ProtectHome=true
ProtectSystem=full

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
UNITEOF
sudo -n systemctl daemon-reload
sudo -n systemctl enable inventory.service
sudo -n systemctl start inventory.service
sleep 2
systemctl is-enabled inventory.service
systemctl is-active inventory.service
